items.prompt: Edit the existing isolated NESCAFÉ paper cup render into a real studio product photograph. Preserve the exact tapered silhouette, viewing angle, bottom folded edge, black body, red shape, exact white NESCAFÉ wordmark, registered mark, spacing, placement and scale. Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied isolated blue Heylife paper espresso cup render. Convert this exact render into convincing premium studio product photography by changing ONLY paper material and photographic lighting. Preserve all printed artwork: exact blue, white shapes, stars, shooting star, dots, peace-hand details, smile, exact HEY LIFE! BAKERY logo and lettering, spacing, layout, positions and scale as on the render. Do not invent, remove or relocate print. Fine coated food-grade cellulose microfibres and delicate natural paper grain, compressed rolled-paper rim, neatly completed curved folded-paper base; keep the narrow cream base cuff. Soft large studio key from upper left, controlled fill, neutral white balance, rich faithful blue ink and naturally shaded interior. Texture is fine and subtle, not pebbled, leather, cloth, plastic or ceramic. 85mm product photography, f/11, whole cup sharply in focus. Genuinely transparent alpha directly outside the actual silhouette; no white glow/halo/haze, no floor shadow outside the product, no background, no props, no dimensions/captions/collage and no crop. Match the source portrait 2:3 framing.

Precise image edit for a real paper cup catalogue photograph. The ONLY attached image is the correct geometric target. Retain its silhouette without any vertical stretching. The product must look squat enough to match THIS 9 oz cup, not a tall 12 oz cup. Its complete visible height is exactly about 1.18 times the maximum rim width. This is a hard framing/proportion requirement. In a 1024x1536 portrait output, the cup should span approximately x=66..958 and y=238..1291: width about 892 px, height about 1053 px. Keep the same shallow opening ellipse and near-frontal camera. Keep the taper and the width of the exposed lower white paper base exactly. Do not elongate the upper printed wall. Do not distort the letters to achieve the shape. Copy the entire diagonal red and white ALVICA artwork from the target faithfully, all wording, cursive lettering, glyph shapes, spacing, placements and relative print scale unchanged. Change ONLY the material/light rendering from CGI to premium real studio product photography: fine smooth coated cellulose paper with very subtle fibres, rich deep warm red ink and crisp white print, realistic rolled paper lip, naturally shaded interior, gently rounded folded lower base edge. Studio softbox from upper left with fill, neutral white balance, controlled highlights, all sharp. No exaggerated grain, no plastic, no leather. True transparent alpha outside the actual product, no backdrop, no floor, no shadow or glow outside cup, no props, captions or dimensions. The result must be visibly broader/less elongated than the previous ALVICA cup. Match the attached native render dimensions exactly: full cup height / maximum rim width = 1.18.
